ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_weighted_logsigmoid_advantage_gap_margin_tanh_scaled
ir.intuition: To reduce similarity with prior candidates, replaced the raw margin with a smooth nonlinear margin using a scaled tanh to soften the margin effect dynamically. Also introduced scaling of advantage_gap with sigmoid to limit its weight between 0 and 1, avoiding clamping which was too similar to previous relu-based clamping. This smooths the influence of advantage_gap and margin, enhancing novelty while maintaining the margin-shifted logsigmoid loss structure, promoting stability and interpretability.
ir.pseudocode:
raw_margin = 0.5
scaled_margin = raw_margin * tanh(log_prob_w - log_prob_l)
score_diff = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) - scaled_margin
adv_gap_scaled = sigmoid(advantage_gap)
loss = -logsigmoid(score_diff) * adv_gap_scaled * weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    raw_margin = 0.5
    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(raw_margin, ops.tanh(diff))
    score_diff = ops.sub(diff, scaled_margin)
    adv_gap_scaled = ops.sigmoid(adv_gap)
    loss_raw = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(score_diff))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(ops.mul(loss_raw, adv_gap_scaled), weight)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
